thread:
noah: kicking off production rollout for v2.14.2 at 02:10 UTC. staggered by region, canary in us-west1 + eu-west1. starting post-deploy smoke: embed-route, tokenization-short, kv-prefill. please watch p95 and 5xx.

deploy-bot: rollout started: service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:v2.14.2 mode=staggered postdeploy=enabled. synth jobs dispatched.

hema: quick FYI — seeing tokenization-short probe tail in eu-west1 creeping from 220ms to ~900ms on a handful of samples. no 5xx yet.

luca: same in us-west1 but fewer samples. CPU on host pool-ux-3 shows short spikes ~95%. Might be concurrency ramp on quant path.

noah: hold the next wave. pausing rollout after current canary. hema, can you run a targeted probe against the quant-lite variant to compare? if quant path is the issue we'll consider pinning to quant-stable variant.

synth-agent: probe report tokenization-short-eu-west1 summary: samples=80 p50=210ms p95=870ms errors=0 slow_count=7. probe payloads attached.

hema: ran quick A/B: quant-lite p95=880ms, quant-stable p95=260ms for same short prompt set. Suspect kernel selection falling back to slower path under burst concurrency.

luca: adding logs: ```[2026-03-24T02:12:05Z] host=pool-ux-3 cpu=94% threadpool=busy kernel=quant-light fallback=true```. Also noticed increased kv-prefill miss rate on same hosts.

noah: decision: pin routing for eu-west1 to image variant v2.14.2-quant-stable (same code, different runtime knobs) while we root cause. We are NOT rolling back full image. hema, run the pin CLI and dry-run first.

hema: dry-run: ```rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.14.2 --to v2.14.2-quant-stable --dry-run --reason "postdeploy tokenization p95 spike"```

deploy-bot: route-pin dry-run complete: service=inference-api region=eu-west1 candidate=v2.14.2-quant-stable OK.

hema: applying pin now. ```rictl route pin --service inference-api --region eu-west1 --from v2.14.2 --to v2.14.2-quant-stable --reason "postdeploy tokenization p95 spike" --ticket none```

deploy-bot: action=route-pin status=applied service=inference-api region=eu-west1 pinned_to=v2.14.2-quant-stable actor=hema ts=3291248975

opsbot: synth re-run summary after pin (eu-west1): samples=90 p50=230ms p95=270ms errors=0 slow_count=1. kv-prefill miss rate reverted to baseline.

luca: looks stable in eu after pin. us-west1 still showing occasional spikes but below threshold.

noah: good. action items: 1) hold global ramp for 30m 2) add release note amendment documenting eu pin to quant-stable variant and rationale 3) create follow-up ticket to investigate kernel selection under concurrency (assign to infra/rt) 4) schedule controlled re-roll to reintroduce quant-lite during low-traffic window after telemetry.

hema: updating release notes & change window now. tagging infra for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

noah: if error rate >5% or p95 >20% from baseline in next 30m, escalate and open incident. otherwise we'll resume rollout at +30m with extra sampling.

luca: ack. keeping an eye on host CPU and kv-prefill for the window.

noah: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regression. :thumbsup:
